description: Defines the interface for media muxers, including the Muxer class, its nested VideoParameters struct, and related methods for encoding video/audio data, controlling output, and managing muxer state.

classes.name: Muxer
classes.description: Interface for media muxers that handle encoded audio/video data and mux it into a container format.

classes.name: VideoParameters
classes.description: Container for parameters used by the muxer, extracted from VideoFrame, including size, frame rate, codec, and color space.

methods.name: SetMaximumDurationToForceDataOutput
methods.description: Sets the maximum duration after which the muxer outputs a data chunk.

methods.name: OnEncodedVideo
methods.description: Adds encoded video data to the muxer, with parameters for video info, encoded data, timestamp, and key frame indicator.

methods.name: OnEncodedAudio
methods.description: Adds encoded audio data to the muxer, with parameters for audio info, encoded data, and timestamp.

methods.name: SetLiveAndEnabled
methods.description: Handles mute and track disablement; ignores input if track is not live and enabled.

methods.name: Pause
methods.description: Pauses the muxer, modifying timestamps to last received value.

methods.name: Flush
methods.description: Finalizes and writes out all buffered frames; returns success status.
